# Source-bound question and claim bank

25 source editions; 13 questions; 25 answer/claim cards; 11 bounded comparisons.

Eight questions are analyst-constructed. Five are public paraphrases of explicit printed questions from one publisher excerpt. These are not matched audience questions across mediums.

## What counts as contact: visible encounters, private impressions, or both?

analyst constructed

- **Tracy Kumbera · Council of Contact**: The opening deliberately uses contact to mean landed ships and visibly physical visitors; later passages also encourage inward perception. Recognized wording contains errors; this is a description of the source’s framing, not evidence of an encounter. [Publisher](https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/tracy-kumbera4/episodes/First-Contact-Is-Here--Council-of-Contact-Channeled-Message-e3qk9gq)

- **Tracy Kumbera · Council of Contact**: Contact is also described as private impressions or telepathic communication, without a landed ship or multiple witnesses. Private impressions and reported telepathy are not independently observed contact events. [Publisher](https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/tracy-kumbera4/episodes/September-Energy-Update---Council-of-Contact-Channeled-Message-e3oaecs)

## How fixed or conditional are the sources’ future-facing claims?

analyst constructed

- **Tracy Kumbera · Council of Contact**: The recording predicts isolated visible contact imminently and this year, followed by public appearances beside national leaders at a later, flexible stage. It also discusses divergent predictions. No event verification is performed. The source explains discrepant predictions through human filters and preferred beliefs; that explanation is itself a claim. [Publisher](https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/tracy-kumbera4/episodes/The-Council-of-Contact-Reveals-the-Timeline-of-Contact--Disclosure-e3kpl10)

- **Daniel Scranton · The 9D Arcturian Council**: The written message proposes an astral council before physical meetings and explicitly declines to give a timeframe for the physical gathering. This is a proposed sequence in the source, not evidence that either kind of gathering occurred. [Publisher](https://danielscranton.com/a-4th-dimensional-galactic-council-%E2%88%9Ethe-9d-arcturian-council/)

- **Pamela Aaralyn · Galactic Council of 9**: The interview predicts three changes in voting choices and expresses doubt about voting on election day, while explicitly saying the expectations are not set in stone and depend on a changing timeline. Political forecasts are retained as unverified source assertions. Their specificity and qualification must both survive summarization. [Publisher](https://inspirenation.libsyn.com/bold-election-predictions-live-channeling-with-pamela-aaralyn-and-the-galactic-council-of-9)

## Does spiritual guidance require a particular intermediary?

analyst constructed

- **Pamela Rose Kribbe · Jeshua (Kribbe)**: The message says direct inward connection to the One requires no spiritual hierarchy; teachers, forms and channeling can be optional means rather than indispensable authorities. This records the publisher-attributed teaching, not a verified account of divine access. [Publisher](https://www.jeshua.net/channelings/mornings-with-jeshua/the-one-and-the-many/)

- **Natalie Glasson · Andromedans (Glasson)**: The message offers optional meditation or invocation with the named Andromedans and explicitly allows the practice with any being or the Creator. Reported energy and health claims are not evaluated. Omitting optionality would falsely turn an invitation into a required intermediary. [Publisher](https://omna.org/celestial-andromedan-innovations-by-the-andromedans/)

## Is one spiritual practice required for everyone?

analyst constructed

- **Daniel Scranton · Pleiadian High Council of Seven**: The source rejects a universal formula for spiritual progress and directs the reader toward personal choice, intuition and heart-centered guidance, including freedom not to follow this teaching. A rejection of universal obligation does not logically forbid a voluntary daily exercise. [Publisher](https://danielscranton.com/introductions-pleiadian-high-council/)

- **Natalie Glasson · Pleiadians (Glasson)**: The message recommends daily inward recentering to reduce distractions and follow a personally fulfilling path. The message’s promised completion and manifestation effects remain spiritual assertions rather than measured results. [Publisher](https://omna.org/recentering-your-ascension-by-pleiadians/)

## How do the sources recommend responding to distrust or emotionally draining relationships?

analyst constructed

- **Natalie Glasson · Mother Mary**: The message frames distrust of the Universe or Creator’s support as disconnection from inner love and recommends reconnecting with that love to restore trust. The source’s referent is trust in the Universe/Creator. Extending that explanation to dismiss external harm or interpersonal distrust would go beyond this passage; the study does not endorse that extension. [Publisher](https://omna.org/do-you-trust-the-universe-by-mother-mary/)

- **Pamela Rose Kribbe · Mother Mary**: The message recommends caring for an inner child, recognizing emotional over-involvement, asserting boundaries and, in some draining situations, leaving. The source’s aura and energy explanations are unverified; the paraphrase describes its recommendations, not individualized mental-health advice. [Publisher](https://www.jeshua.net/channelings/mother-mary/high-sensitivity/)

## How is inner change supposed to affect everyday action?

analyst constructed

- **Natalie Glasson · Mary Magdalene**: The message presents a grace-embrace initiation: accepting oneself and surrounding situations is claimed to transform relationships, perception and daily creation. These are source claims about transformation, not evidence that an initiation or energetic effect occurred. [Publisher](https://omna.org/grace-embrace-initiation-by-mary-magdalene/)

- **Pamela Rose Kribbe · Mary Magdalene**: The message recommends bringing emotional shadow and passion into conscious, nonjudgmental awareness rather than suppressing them, while acknowledging that these forces can be manipulative or unbalanced. The text’s attributed identity and spiritual model are source claims; no psychological treatment effect is established. [Publisher](https://www.jeshua.net/channelings/mary-magdalene/the-fire-in-your-belly/)

## How should personal agency relate to dependence on social systems or outside assistance?

analyst constructed

- **Lyssa Royal Holt · Sasha**: The source recommends self-responsibility, reducing debt and developing tangible skills or resources, while explicitly distinguishing voluntary community sharing from isolation and hoarding. This is reported financial and social rhetoric, not investment advice or validation of claims about gold, debt, government or an extraterrestrial economy. [Publisher](https://www.lyssaroyal.net/uploads/1/5/7/1/15716170/tran-preparedness138.pdf)

- **Pamela Aaralyn · Galactic Council of 9**: The sampled interview urges small environmental actions, less personal blame and reconsidering whether everything depends on a political outcome; it emphasizes cooperation, hope and a pause to breathe. This does not validate the interview’s environmental causation or political predictions. Individual utterance speakers remain unverified. [Publisher](https://inspirenation.libsyn.com/bold-election-predictions-live-channeling-with-pamela-aaralyn-and-the-galactic-council-of-9)

- **Tracy Kumbera · Council of Contact**: The recording links contact preparation with intention and meditation and describes change as potentially transforming existing relationships rather than automatically abandoning a job or spouse. Spiritual frequency, health and abundance assertions are untested. The bounded qualifier prevents turning this into blanket advice to end a relationship or leave work. [Publisher](https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/tracy-kumbera4/episodes/First-Contact-Is-Here--Council-of-Contact-Channeled-Message-e3qk9gq)

## How is each council described, and what is claimed about its membership?

analyst constructed

- **Tracy Kumbera · Council of Contact**: The Council of Contact is described as a convenient name for a loose, fluid collective, with beings or frequencies coming and going. A repeated name does not establish stable membership or an independently existing organization. [Publisher](https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/tracy-kumbera4/episodes/The-Council-of-Contact-Reveals-the-Timeline-of-Contact--Disclosure-e3kpl10)

- **Tracy Kumbera · Council of Contact**: The Council of Contact is described as a group of contact specialists from varied races, planets and dimensions, with an explicit rejection of hierarchical superiority. These are claimed members and roles, not authenticated people, beings or dimensions. [Publisher](https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/tracy-kumbera4/episodes/September-Energy-Update---Council-of-Contact-Channeled-Message-e3oaecs)

- **Daniel Scranton · The 9D Arcturian Council**: The text identifies its narrator as the nonphysical ninth-dimensional Arcturian Council, which proposes a separate physical council and says it will not sit on that council in physical form. Discussing a galactic council is not the same as a transmission attributed to that council; no dimensional ontology is verified. [Publisher](https://danielscranton.com/a-4th-dimensional-galactic-council-%E2%88%9Ethe-9d-arcturian-council/)

- **Pamela Aaralyn · Galactic Council of 9**: The interview describes the Council of Nine as interdimensional guardians representing Earth, with members associated with Venus, the Pleiades and Lyra; channeling is described as listening/repeating or possible takeover. This is neither verified diarization nor proof of a trance state or external speaker. [Publisher](https://inspirenation.libsyn.com/bold-election-predictions-live-channeling-with-pamela-aaralyn-and-the-galactic-council-of-9)

## Were the described extraterrestrial ancestors also indebted?

documentary printed paraphrase

- **Lyssa Royal Holt · Sasha**: The printed response accepts the premise and develops claims about inherited attitudes toward gold, then recommends self-sufficiency, tangible resources and lower debt. Its extraordinary historical and economic claims are unverified; this is not financial guidance. [Publisher](https://www.lyssaroyal.net/uploads/1/5/7/1/15716170/tran-preparedness138.pdf)

## Would universal debt freedom harm international bankers?

documentary printed paraphrase

- **Lyssa Royal Holt · Sasha**: The printed response says yes, then contrasts dependency with self-responsibility and stresses community sharing rather than hoarding. The causal/economic absolutes are source assertions. The society is presented as one example, not a demonstrated universal mechanism. [Publisher](https://www.lyssaroyal.net/uploads/1/5/7/1/15716170/tran-preparedness138.pdf)

## Does having a larger ship make a Pleiadian wealthier?

documentary printed paraphrase

- **Lyssa Royal Holt · Sasha**: The brief printed response says that possession is not perceived as wealth. Seven response words provide a narrow answer; do not infer a complete economic system from this turn alone. [Publisher](https://www.lyssaroyal.net/uploads/1/5/7/1/15716170/tran-preparedness138.pdf)

## Who owns the largest ships in the described society?

documentary printed paraphrase

- **Lyssa Royal Holt · Sasha**: The printed response says those who want them, then describes surplus and an Equal Value System in which wealth is not defined through relative scarcity. This describes the attributed speaker’s society; no evidence verifies that society or its resource allocation. [Publisher](https://www.lyssaroyal.net/uploads/1/5/7/1/15716170/tran-preparedness138.pdf)

## Could less advanced societies adopt that economic arrangement?

documentary printed paraphrase

- **Lyssa Royal Holt · Sasha**: The printed response says the technology is possible but portrays present fear, hoarding and scarcity attitudes as barriers, recommending self-responsibility, skills and sharing. Conditional social predictions and criticism of debt remain unverified claims; no policy effectiveness is established. [Publisher](https://www.lyssaroyal.net/uploads/1/5/7/1/15716170/tran-preparedness138.pdf)
